parts.name: Tabletop Surface
parts.Basic_description: This is the tabletop surface of a wooden table, forming the main flat area used for placing items.
parts.Functional_description: It provides a stable and flat surface for supporting objects such as dishes, books, or tools.
parts.Movement_description: It is fixed and does not move relative to the table frame.

parts.name: Tabletop Dropleaf
parts.Basic_description: This is the dropleaf section of the table, made of wood and attached to the main tabletop with hinges.
parts.Functional_description: It extends the usable surface area of the table when lifted and supported, and can be folded down to save space.
parts.Movement_description: It rotates about a hinge joint, allowing it to fold up or down depending on use.
